description: Mechanism test for the E050 16 px collapse, with a small time saving. Base: E069. Make one change: the first-stage resolution goes from 20 px to 18 px (F.interpolate, antialias=True, inside the compiled augment). This should keep a 2x2 final map. In drafts/, print the per-block sizes first; expect whitening 17, then pools 8/4/2. If the final map is not 2x2, abort and record why. Use a static-kernel F.max_pool2d for the final pool (no amax). Stage boundaries in samples, the whitening-bias freeze at 50000, and all schedules stay unchanged. Warm up the 18 px graphs, with and without whitening-bias grad, plus every partial shape at 50000 and 75000 in build() with channels_last tensors. Run debug_nan.py. Gate offline: on seeds 3-12 paired against E069, launch on seeds 0-2 only if the paired delta is >=-0.05 pp and offline train time is <=-0.5%.
